legal_privacy_meta_description: How {siteName} handles account emails, pet photos, generated portraits and payment records.
legal_privacy_intro: This policy covers the {siteName} demo at pet.shipwords.yololab.cc.
legal_privacy_collect_body: We store the email address you sign in with, the photos you upload, the portraits generated for you, credit and order records, and basic technical logs such as IP address, browser and timestamps.
legal_privacy_processors_body: Cloudflare hosts the site, stores uploads and sends sign-in emails. Stripe processes payments when checkout is enabled. Yir runs AI generation. Google handles sign-in when you choose Google. We do not sell personal data.
legal_privacy_retention_body: Uploaded photos and generated portraits stay with your account until you delete them or ask us to remove them. Account and payment records are kept as long as needed for tax and dispute handling.
legal_privacy_cookies_body: Cookies are first-party only: a session cookie keeps you signed in and a short-lived cookie records attribution. We use no advertising cookies.
legal_privacy_choices_body: You can request access or deletion by emailing support@pet.shipwords.yololab.cc. You must be at least 18 to use the site.
legal_terms_meta_description: The terms that apply when you use {siteName}.
legal_terms_intro: These terms cover the {siteName} pet portrait generator.
legal_terms_service_body: The site turns a photo and a text prompt into an AI-generated pet portrait for personal use. This demo may run in mock mode and return sample results.
legal_terms_content_body: Only upload photos you own or have permission to use. Do not upload images of people, minors or content you intend to pass off as real. You keep rights to your uploads, and you may use the generated portrait personally.
legal_terms_credits_body: Generations cost credits. Credit packs are one-time purchases and unused credits do not expire. Refund conditions are on the refund policy page.
legal_terms_warranty_body: AI results are provided as-is and may differ from what you imagined. We are not liable for indirect damages. We may update these terms and will post the new date on this page.
legal_refunds_meta_description: When credits are returned automatically and how to ask for a manual refund.
legal_refunds_intro: This policy explains when {siteName} returns credits or money.
legal_refunds_failed_body: Credits come back automatically only when no portrait could be produced, for example when the model failed or refused. Once a portrait is delivered, its credits are used even if you dislike the style; a clearly broken result can be refunded by email.
legal_refunds_unused_body: Unused credits from a pack can be refunded within 14 days of purchase, minus payment fees, provided no credits from that pack were used.
legal_refunds_ask_body: Email support@pet.shipwords.yololab.cc with your account email and order reference. We reply within two business days.
legal_dmca_meta_description: How to report infringing content on {siteName}.
legal_dmca_intro: We remove content that infringes copyright when a valid notice reaches us.
legal_dmca_notice_body: Email support@pet.shipwords.yololab.cc with the copyrighted work, the URL of the content, your contact details, a good-faith statement and a statement under penalty of perjury that the information is accurate.
legal_dmca_counter_body: If your content was removed, reply with your contact details, identification of the removed material and a statement consenting to jurisdiction. We may restore the content after the statutory period.
legal_dmca_repeat_body: Accounts that repeatedly upload infringing content may be suspended or terminated.
